verdict.rationale: Jules is operated by submitting tasks and messages to the agent: the docs describe submitting a task that becomes a reviewable plan, and sending messages to the agent via the API. Hands-on users report driving it with prompts and pasted error messages, even from a phone and by non-developer customers. Missing for 10: first-party docs that explicitly describe natural-language prompting, and evidence of reliable multi-turn control (users report it looping after a few prompts with no stop button).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
